summary: SessionSwitcher takes variant="list" for an always visible chat list (new chat, recent chats, rename, delete, arrow keys) and onSelect, called after a pick or a new chat.
howTo: Render <SessionSwitcher variant="list" onSelect={() => …} /> in an own side column; it needs a chat that keeps several conversations (renders nothing otherwise). Texts: locale.chatHistoryLabel (navigation name) and locale.recentChatsLabel (heading); German ships. onSelect also works on the default dropdown.
